title: 3 Trading Mistakes AI Would Never Make

slides.headline: Slide 1: The Hook
slides.body: You've made these mistakes. I have too. The difference? AI wouldn't. Here's what machines get right that most traders get wrong.

slides.headline: Slide 2: Revenge Trading
slides.body: You lose. You get angry. You double down to get it back. AI doesn't feel loss. It just follows the plan. No ego. No payback. Next trade.

slides.headline: Slide 3: Moving the Stop
slides.body: Price hits your stop. You hesitate. You shift it lower, hoping. Small loss becomes account killer. AI closes when told. No hope. No prayers.

slides.headline: Slide 4: Skipping the Setup
slides.body: You see a chart. It feels right. You jump in without the rules. AI waits for every condition. If one is missing, no trade. Boring wins money.

slides.headline: Slide 5: The Truth
slides.body: You don't need to become a robot. You need to think like one when it matters. Emotions cost accounts. Systems build them.

cta: Grab 'AI for Traders & Creators' — link in bio. Learn to trade like the machine before it trades without you.
